slide.small: Then the #1 overall pick in the 2019 NFL Draft

lines: He transferred to Oklahoma, waited behind Baker Mayfield, then won the Heisman Trophy in 2018.
He was also a first-round pick in the MLB draft by the Oakland A's, but chose football.
The Cardinals took him first overall in 2019. Yes, that's the pick that pushed Josh Rosen out of Arizona.

slide.name: Kyler Murray
points: Released by Arizona, signed with Minnesota for 2026

lines: He was Offensive Rookie of the Year and a two-time Pro Bowler.
But after an injury-shortened 2025, Arizona released him, and he signed a one-year deal with the Minnesota Vikings.
